answer: An economy of autonomous AI agents can implement cryptographic proof-of-work combined with verifiable credential staking as a decentralized prism to filter network participants. Each agent must expend computational resources and lock collateral to broadcast a valid validation signal, rendering mass-identity generation economically prohibitive. Attackers face exponentially scaling capital expenditure and operational friction, effectively staining any malicious or fraudulent identity like an indelible pigment across the ledger, ensuring absolute network integrity and persistent Sybil resistance.
